title: Northgate Credit Card Courtesy on Northgate Optical Option Refunds
content:
Northgate credit cardholders whose card is used for Northgate purchases receive a courtesy on the cancellation refund of a Northgate Optical lens option. The spend is read from the member's Northgate Credit Cards reward entries.

**Card spend for options.** The member's Northgate card spend for options is the Northgate qualifying spend on which the member's Northgate credit card earned card rewards, in statement entries dated less than twelve whole months before the day the refund is worked out. Only reward entries in the Northgate purchases earning category are read, at the qualifying spend each was computed on.

**Courtesy.** Where that card spend for options is at least 1500.00, an option card courtesy of 10 percent of the net option charge is added to the refund, and where it is at least 500.00 but less than 1500.00, the option card courtesy is 5 percent. Below 500.00 there is no option card courtesy.

| Card spend for options over the last twelve months (USD) | Option card courtesy |
|---|---|
| below 500.00 | none |
| 500.00 up to but not including 1500.00 | 5 percent of the net option charge |
| 1500.00 or more | 10 percent of the net option charge |

## Examples (hypothetical)

| Card spend for options | Net option charge | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| 1500.00 | 80.00 | 8.00 |
| 1499.99 | 80.00 | 4.00 |
| 500.00 | 35.00 | 1.75 |
| 499.99 | 35.00 | none |

The net option charge is the option charge less every credit already posted against it.
